groups.kjvPhrase: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
by this epistle, note that man
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
groups.webPhrase: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
